checks.name: dev-build-receipt
checks.scope: Warm no-change incremental build and the named product recipe test; no equivalent-work speedup claim

failed_attempts: Initial test compilation used incorrect Mesh bounds and mutable JSON helper APIs; corrected before running those checks.
Older contract assertions expected 95 tools and future source42; updated for the observed 96 tools and future source43.
The first UI fixture omitted expected_revision for doc_new; it was rejected and the fixture was corrected.

Live Studio-MCP preview crashed with presence enabled; an off/on diagnostic isolated the overlay. Caller VAO, buffer, program and viewport restoration plus busy-preview regression tests fixed the observed failure without changing timeouts.
Generic feature.edit appearance replacement reset other light controls; light_up now merges lighting controls while retaining existing appearances and materials.

Sheet circle/slot acceptance inputs initially used spaces in entity-ID prefixes and were explicitly rejected; valid identity prefixes and early validation retain the producer contract. A duplicate validation insertion caused one compile failure and was removed.
limits: Scope uses synthetic local CAD inputs, actual host tool calls and synthetic role state events. No general live-provider design quality or cost result is claimed.
Wood stock and rectangular top-face joinery are exact; structural, anisotropic, joint-fit and manufacturing qualification remain open.
Networks are authored triangle tubes with nominal sag/weave; cloth mechanics, contact and self-intersection checks remain open.
LED emission and bloom are raster display controls, not calibrated photometry or illumination of neighboring parts.
Hosted CI for 030D, fresh relocated distribution, signing, published OTA transport and production qualification are not established by these local checks.
